name: Doc Code Block
description: An IDE-style code block with a file-path header. Optional traffic-light dots on the left of the header. Pick a language for auto syntax highlighting.

field_schema.label: File path / header
field_schema.help: Shown in the header bar, e.g. 'config.yaml' or 'themes/foo/theme.tengo'.

field_schema.label: Show window dots
field_schema.help: Toggle the three coloured dots on the left of the header.

field_schema.label: Language
field_schema.help: Auto syntax highlighter applies on render. 'tengo' falls back to plaintext (no native lexer).

field_schema.label: Code
field_schema.help: Use the WYSIWYG code-block button (or paste raw code) — highlighter runs on render.

test_data.body:
themes/<slug>/
  theme.json               # manifest
  layouts/*.html           # page-level templates
  partials/*.html          # reusable fragments
  blocks/<slug>/           # content blocks (block.json + view.html)
  assets/                  # CSS, JS, images
  scripts/theme.tengo      # seed entry point
  templates/*.json         # page templates for editors
  forms/*.html             # themed form layouts
